name: backissue
title: Back Issue
description: A small-press zine theme on natural uncoated stock, typewriter mono under poster condensed capitals, whose every title is printed in two passes: deep blue type over a fluorescent-pink copy of itself, knocked a few pixels out of register.

tokens.--font-poster: poster condensed capitals: the site title, every title, headings inside a piece, the subscribe heading
tokens.--font-mono: typewriter mono: body text, the menu, dates, tags, buttons, the footer
tokens.--text-xs: the small capital labels: menu, date stamps, tags, pager, buttons, the footer's name line
tokens.--text-s: secondary text: standfirsts, the cover's strapline, tables, code blocks, the footer
tokens.--text-xl: the big title at the top of every page
tokens.--text-cover: the site title on the home page's cover
tokens.--text-mast: the site title on every other page
tokens.--leading-poster: line spacing of the condensed capitals
tokens.--tracking-mono: letter spacing of the small capital labels
tokens.--color-bg: page background: natural uncoated stock; also the e-mail field
tokens.--color-text: the deep spot blue: all text and links, rules, the frame of the subscribe box, focus rings
tokens.--color-muted: lighter blue for secondary text: standfirsts, archive descriptions, the strapline, the footer, table rules
tokens.--color-accent: the fluorescent pink of the second pass: the off-register copy of every title, the pink rule under each blue rule, link underlines, list markers
tokens.--color-flood: pink flood blocks: behind the cover title and page titles, date stamps, the current menu entry, quotation bars, the subscribe box, selections and link hovers
tokens.--color-on-flood: the set overlap colour: text printed on a flood block (dates, the current menu entry, the subscribe box and its button)
tokens.--ink-blend: how the blue pass prints over the pink: multiply on paper, screen on black
tokens.--cover-blend: how a cover picture prints over its pink flood block
tokens.--misreg-x: how far the pink pass lands to the side of the blue
tokens.--misreg-y: how far the pink pass lands below the blue
tokens.--date-col: width of the date column in the archive, and of the margin beside a piece's text on a wide screen
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: inside menu links, between menu entries side by side, above and below a quotation
tokens.--space-2: small gap: between tags, between wrapped menu rows, between form parts, under a date stamp on a phone
tokens.--space-3: paragraph spacing and the gap under a standfirst
tokens.--space-4: gap between blocks and between archive entries
tokens.--space-5: the air above page titles and around the subscribe box
tokens.--rule: thickness of rules, borders and the frame of the subscribe box
tokens.--rule-thin: thickness of tag outlines and table rules
